
## Reviewing specs & plans
After writing or substantially revising a spec, plan, proposal, or design doc in a repo, proactively use the `peer-review` skill to get an independent peer review (Codex, Gemini, and — when a Fireworks key is set — open-weight models such as DeepSeek and Kimi) before presenting the doc as complete. Do the same for a decision record, a legal draft, or a letter that goes out under my name, before the deletion, filing or send it leads to. Skip for trivial edits; a short letter is not one. Do this without being asked.

**Report the findings only — do not edit the document.** This fires without me asking, so surface what the engines found and let me decide what to act on. Note that a review sends the document's full text to OpenAI, Google, and — if enabled — Fireworks AI; if the project's instructions carry a rule on outside review, follow it; if there is none and the document contains anything I wouldn't send to a third party, say so and ask before running, rather than skipping the review on your own.
